text: just seen a girl trying to recreate the cinnamon bun matcha in her kitchen. no whisk. no sieve. no scales. no blank street. just a mug, a fork and a cinnamon jar she's shaking like it owes her money. tasting it off a spoon between attempts. Genuinely unwell
base_video: Creator sits at a kitchen counter holding their own iced drink, looking off camera and slowly raising the cup an inch like a toast, no smile.
caption: she's on attempt four. who do you know like this
why_this_brand: Blank Street's autumn Cinnamon Bun Matcha is a named seasonal drink on the site, and the home version of it is exactly the clumpy fork-and-mug failure their matcha drinkers walk past on the way to work.
what_changed: Cut 'she drank it standing up' so the fork and the lumpy mug stay the single image.

format.reason: Blank Street's pull is the relatable morning ritual, the clumpy fork-whisked matcha at home and the queue you don't have time for, which lands hardest as a silent reacting face plus one block of text about the old way. It also avoids needing brand-supplied demo footage, and app ordering is a behaviour change more than a thing to watch working.
format.why_not_runner_up: A drink being handed over is a weak demo and it needs footage the brand would have to shoot first.

editor_fix: cut 'she drank it standing up' or the sink clause, one of the two is padding, and tighten so the fork stays the single image.
